name: Aldarra (Sammamish plateau forest, Fall City WA)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json), made against the NAIP photo of the course (2026-11-13). Aldarra lies on the forested Sammamish plateau above the Snoqualmie valley: a private Fazio course with no houses on it, every hole in its own clearing of Douglas fir, western red cedar and big-leaf maple; the rough a rich wet-side green, the fairways an even emerald, white-cream sand, black-green ponds and wetlands; off the course (L0-L2) the plateau's pasture and forest floor, a warmer olive. Trees: western red cedar and Pacific madrone (assets-src/trees_aldarra.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
